scope: Stage 5 coordinated loop facade, complete public lifecycle example, independent integrated media/state/content/ownership checks, protocol-preserving pedal-edge work refinement, and existing-runtime regressions. Not live topology/program replacement or independent loop-host acceptance.

lifetime_proof.result: Positive production-trait proof and deliberate E0502 rejection.

capture_authority.result: Positive planner authority and deliberate consumer E0599 rejection.

limitations: Not a whole-workspace or whole-suite Miri claim.
Loom's generator/FFI model runs natively, not under Miri.
Long seeded loops and two-thread stress use explicitly smaller cfg(miri) counts; full counts run natively and applicable cases in Node/Chromium.
Browser/Web Audio/JavaScript and external C++ tracing are not interpreted; real-worklet and native tracing gates cover them separately.

miri_run_shape: 159 fresh selected executions in one complete invocation: 118 runtime plus 41 loop. Ten facade tests use exact individual filters; every profile/workload runs unchanged on native/Wasm/Miri. Per-command watchdog remains 900 seconds; no stack limit or guard exemption.

prior_miri_timeout.reason: Dense full-profile facade case exceeded the real 900-second subprocess watchdog; no success claimed. The interpreter child was observed and explicitly terminated. Runner now kills/reaps its process group on timeout and preserves output.

dense_refinement.production_change: Controller values remain updated. Sostenuto scans keys only on pedal edges; sustain/hold releases scan only on down-to-up edges, and release-unheld returns immediately while another sustain/hold is down. No event is dropped or delayed.
dense_refinement.fixture_change: Playback-only dense test provisions two MIDI versions with one checkpoint each instead of eight versions with eight rows. Two immutable imports contain one/two events, below replay span 128. No recording is requested in this case. All three 128-frame profiles, full packets, samples, journals, unread results, guards and cleanup assertions remain unchanged on every platform. Other capture/exhaustion fixtures retain their original capacities.
dense_refinement.timing_limits: The isolated production-refinement command passed at 890.36 seconds wall time before the fixture-storage reduction. Full-run harness times are simulated Miri times, not wall measurements. No stable speedup/deadline claim.

three_hold_model.method: Independent ordered key map, held/latch flags and three pedal arrays; unconditional reference release evaluation, all current-channel keys each step and all channels each sixty-four steps, exact controller values. Covers note-on/off, sustain/sostenuto/hold repeats/edges, sound-off/all-notes-off/reset. Same native/Wasm/Miri workload.

integrated_oracles.stereo_midi_graph: Host input and loop playback feed a separate mixing/gain effect; effect feeds host and capture. Exact sample arrays, complete MIDI restoration/original/cleanup packets, semantic events and exported bytes/durations are independent expectations.
integrated_oracles.partitions: Whole, all-single and irregular partitions; reversed declaration order; journals zero/one/1024. Dense case covers 128 one-sample boundaries, all 32 normal runtime results unread, exact packet stream and independent recovery stop.
integrated_oracles.recording: Immediate record-to-play, old-playback/new-capture, repeated Record, stopped-input initial state and half-open prefix snapshots, imported watermark (revision seven then capture eight), selected retained old media, seek/gain/smoothing and late requested/delivered/terminal times.
integrated_oracles.refusals: Insufficient checkpoint rows, metadata exhaustion on repeated Record, optional tail-copy Budget refusal with no partial export, independently predicted physical-page exhaustion prefix under three partitions, malformed preparation/operations and imported revision MAX refusal.
integrated_oracles.ownership: Export initial state assembled from all sixteen immutable channel replies, complete resource reads, residency retirement/stale media, queued/delivered cancellation and recovery with normal slots/results saturated, partially staged interface-fault extraction, idempotent cleanup and full page/version/snapshot/media-reference recovery.
integrated_oracles.scope_limits: Actual facade MIDI success/cleanup paths are integrated here; dedicated original-packet overflow/reset/audio-isolation coverage is retained in the six indexed-MIDI operation cases. Inter-loop/composite integration, live topology/program activation and independent loop hosts remain later stages.

public_example.lifecycle: Stereo plus MIDI, input initial held note, interior immediate play, repeated wraps, seek, distinct new recording and retained-original replacement, stop/cleanup, immutable audio/MIDI export and complete owner recovery.

initial_failures.reason: Initial facade compile used the wrong Diagnostics module and one instead of two AudioBlock lifetimes; corrected the API names/signature.
Fixture used midi_events/midi_bytes instead of Config midi_events_per_port/midi_bytes_per_port.
Initial graph exceeded the fixture port budget of sixteen; provisioned twenty-four without changing the graph/workload.
The successful-record oracle encountered actual preflight refusal: four MIDI checkpoint rows were insufficient for the declared 512-event interval bound.
Owning scheduled admission was incorrectly asserted Applied rather than Scheduled; terminal typed results are separate.

Diagnostic terminal results confirmed the insufficient-checkpoint Capacity refusal. The success fixture uses eight rows; a separate negative case retains four and checks refusal/preserved live output.

Replacement MIDI oracle incorrectly restarted monitored recording from already-playing content. Corrected it to continuous monitoring under the existing discontinuity contract; complete packet comparison and musical workload remain.
Initial tracing inventory did not include the three new production modules; added portable-library entries without application tracing dependencies or callback guard exemptions.

source_archive_limits: Exact pre-refinement sources for the Miri timeout are archived and hashed. Earlier API/fixture/oracle failed logs are retained, but each intermediate failed source tree was not separately archived.
